system.description:
AIR EARTH UTILITY WARDING
Tradition verdant
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Area 20-foot emanation
Duration 10 minutes

Fresh air, steady footing and the quiet resilience of the surrounding land follow you.
You and willing allies within the area gain:
a +2-status bonus to Fortitude saves against environmental hazards;
a +2-status bonus to saving throws against inhaled Poison, airborne Disease and harmful natural spores; and
ordinary natural difficult terrain costs 5 feet less additional movement, to a minimum of its normal movement cost.
The spell does not grant Resistance to elemental damage or permit breathing where no breathable atmosphere exists.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the emanation by 10 feet.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 1 hour.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The two +2 status save bonuses are scoped rows on you and your allies in the emanation; the terrain relief is a note.
